name: Bunker Bulwark
appearance: Broad riot-shield soldier in charcoal plate with a shoulder-mounted compact grenade launcher.
attack: Close shield bash or one lobbed concussive grenade; shield is visual armor, not permanent immunity.
projectileConcept: Concussion grenade: tumbling olive canister with blinking amber fuse, fixed landing point; player/floor impact compact smoke and orange sparks, one area hit.

combat.damagePolicy: Raw attack damage before hero armor; no additional legacy 1.8 multiplier for these profiles.
combat.contactDamage: none; damage comes from an explicit attack event

projectile.travelDirections: Draw authored east-facing projectile rotated to velocity where silhouette permits; directional variants for strongly asymmetric projectiles.
projectile.collision: Swept segment test against hero hurt shape and environment; resolve earliest hit exactly once.
projectile.damage: Direct hit and blast cannot both damage the same player. Apply statuses only if damage hit was accepted.
projectile.expiry: Dissipate harmlessly; do not explode on arbitrary lifetime expiry.
projectile.impactArt: Separate from projectile and hero artwork; anchor to collision point; never follow player after resolution.
